you    run npx @mnbny/woof readme to set up woof

agent  › npx @mnbny/woof readme
         Reading the guide and setting up woof…

you    let's add a reusable commit token for this project
       start every message with the ticket ID

agent  › woof init --repo
         Created a woof config in the repo.
       › woof add git.commit --type prompt --repo …
         Saved the commit rule.

you    use woof to commit these changes

agent  › woof get git.commit
         Start every commit message with the ticket ID.
       › git commit -m "GLX-142 Add export command"
